obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems or general-purpose AI models conforming to harmonised standards published in the Official Journal of the EU shall be presumed to conform to the relevant requirements or obligations under this Regulation to the extent those standards cover those requirements or obligations.

The Commission shall, without undue delay, issue standardisation requests to European standardisation organisations covering all high-risk AI requirements and applicable GPAI obligations, including deliverables on resource performance, energy efficiency, and reporting and documentation processes, after consulting the Board, advisory forum, and relevant stakeholders.

Participants in the standardisation process shall seek to promote investment and innovation in AI, strengthen global cooperation on standardisation, take into account existing international standards consistent with Union values and fundamental rights, and ensure multi-stakeholder governance with balanced representation of interests.
